<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C.</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bevan&family=Nunito+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#0C0E14;--navy:#1C2F5C;--red:#A8393A;--gold:#CDA94A;--green:#4B8A58;--cream:#ECE6D6;--muted:#A9AEBB;
--head:'Bevan',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--body:'Nunito Sans','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font:400 1.05rem/1.65 var(--body)}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.25rem}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:400;line-height:1.15}
h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,6.5vw,3.4rem)}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,4.5vw,2.1rem);margin-bottom:.75rem}
h3{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.4rem}
p{max-width:62ch;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}

/* nav */
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(12,14,20,.96);border-bottom:2px solid var(--navy)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-top:.5rem;padding-bottom:.5rem;scrollbar-width:none}
nav img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;mix-blend-mode:lighten;flex:none}
nav a{white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;padding:.5rem .9rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted)}
nav a:hover{color:var(--cream)}
nav a.on{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}

/* shared */
.pg{padding:2rem 0 1rem}
.hero{display:grid;gap:1.5rem;align-items:center;padding:1rem 0 2rem}
.patch{width:min(62vw,260px);mix-blend-mode:lighten;animation:rise .9s ease-out both}
.hero .lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.15rem;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem}
@media(min-width:760px){.hero{grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;gap:3rem}.patch{width:100%}}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem;margin-top:1rem}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.85rem 1.4rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;min-height:46px}
.btn.p{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
.btn.p:hover{background:#DDBC62}
.btn.g{border:2px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.btn.g:hover{background:rgba(205,169,74,.12)}
.sec{padding:1.5rem 0}
.grid{display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:1.25rem}
@media(min-width:760px){.grid.c3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.grid.c2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.card{background:var(--navy);border:2px dashed var(--red);border-radius:26px;padding:1.4rem 1.3rem;outline:6px solid var(--navy);outline-offset:-8px}
.card p{color:#D6D9E2;margin:0}
.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;counter-reset:s;display:grid;gap:.75rem;margin-top:1rem}
.steps li{counter-increment:s;background:var(--navy);border-radius:16px;padding:1rem 1.2rem 1rem 3.4rem;position:relative}
.steps li:before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:1rem;top:.9rem;width:1.8rem;height:1.8rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;text-align:center;line-height:1.8rem}
.steps strong{display:block;color:var(--gold)}
.list{padding-left:1.2rem;max-width:62ch}.list li{margin-bottom:.5rem}
.band{background:var(--navy);border-top:4px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px 6px 26px 26px;padding:1.75rem 1.4rem}
.when{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tiers{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.75rem;margin:1.25rem 0}
.tiers li{background:rgba(12,14,20,.45);border-left:5px solid var(--gold);padding:.75rem 1rem;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0}
.tiers li:nth-child(2){border-left-color:#5E86C9}.tiers li:nth-child(3){border-left-color:var(--green)}
.tiers strong{display:block;font-size:1.1rem}.tiers span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.poster{width:100%;max-width:520px;border-radius:18px;border:2px dashed var(--red);display:block;margin-top:1.25rem}
.tile{display:block;border:2px solid var(--cream);border-radius:14px;padding:.7rem 1rem;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.35}
.tile:hover{background:rgba(236,230,214,.1)}.tile small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}
.gal{columns:2 150px;column-gap:.75rem;margin-top:1rem}
@media(min-width:760px){.gal{columns:3}}
.gal figure{break-inside:avoid;margin:0 0 .75rem}
.gal img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--navy)}
.gal figcaption{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;padding:.3rem .2rem}
.empty{background:var(--navy);border:2px dashed var(--red);border-radius:22px;padding:1.5rem;margin-top:1rem}
details{background:var(--navy);border-radius:14px;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;margin-bottom:.6rem;max-width:62ch}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold)}
details p{margin:.6rem 0 0;color:#D6D9E2}
footer{border-top:2px dashed var(--red);margin-top:2.5rem;padding:1.5rem 0 2.5rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.patch{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<nav aria-label="Main"><div class="wrap">
<img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C. patch">
<a href="#home" data-go="home">Home</a><a href="#about" data-go="about">About</a><a href="#rides" data-go="rides">Rides</a><a href="#gallery" data-go="gallery">Gallery</a><a href="#events" data-go="events">Events</a><a href="#join" data-go="join">Join Us</a><a href="#contact" data-go="contact">Contact</a>
</div></nav>

<main class="wrap">

<!-- HOME -->
<section class="pg" data-page="home">
  <div class="hero">
    <img class="patch" alt="Club patch: a rider on a green motorcycle in a blue badge with red stitching" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    <div>
      <h1>Ride with us. Vryburg's friendliest motorcycle club.</h1>
      <p class="lead">Social rides, joy rides and good company on the open roads of the North West.</p>
      <div class="btns"><a class="btn p" href="#join" data-go="join">Join the crew</a><a class="btn g" href="#rides" data-go="rides">See our rides</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sec">
    <h2>A young crew with plenty of road ahead</h2>
    <p>The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C. is based in the heart of Vryburg and has been riding strong for just over a year. We're a small, friendly crew who love two wheels and good people. Whether you've ridden for decades or you're just looking for a welcoming place on the road, you'll find open arms here.</p>
    <div class="grid c3">
      <div class="card"><h3>Social rides</h3><p>Relaxed group rides at an easy pace, with a good stop along the way for food and stories.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Joy rides</h3><p>Open road, no pressure. Shorter rides for the pure fun of it.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Open arms</h3><p>All riders and all bikes are welcome. Come as you are and ride with us.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><div class="band">
    <h2>Next up: The Mielie 300 Run</h2>
    <p class="when">Saturday 7 November, starts 10:00, at Old Chaps Vryburg</p>
    <p>A 300km ride for the keen, and a day jol for everyone else.</p>
    <div class="btns"><a class="btn p" href="#events" data-go="events">See the details</a></div>
  </div></div>
</section>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section class="pg" data-page="about" hidden>
  <h1>About the club</h1>
  <div class="sec">
    <p>The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C. is a young, energetic motorcycle club based in the heart of Vryburg, North West. We've been riding strong for just over a year, and we're still small, still friendly and still growing, one ride at a time.</p>
    <p>We love social rides, joy rides and good times on two wheels. Whether you're a seasoned rider or new to the road, you'll always find open arms and positive vibes with us.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>What we stand for</h2>
    <div class="grid c2">
      <div class="card"><h3>Friendship first</h3><p>We ride for the company as much as the road.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Everyone's welcome</h3><p>Seasoned rider or newcomer, you'll fit right in.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Ride safe, ride together</h3><p>Nobody gets left behind.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Proudly Vryburg</h3><p>We're rooted in our town and the North West.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>What to expect</h2><p>A warm welcome, a relaxed pace and a good stop somewhere along the way. No pressure and no judgement, just good people on bikes.</p>
    <div class="btns"><a class="btn p" href="#join" data-go="join">Join the crew</a></div></div>
</section>

<!-- RIDES -->
<section class="pg" data-page="rides" hidden>
  <h1>Our rides</h1>
  <p class="muted" style="margin-top:.5rem">Easy pace, good company, and the open road.</p>
  <div class="grid c3">
    <div class="card"><h3>Social rides</h3><p>Group rides at an easy pace, usually ending at a good spot for food and stories.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Joy rides</h3><p>Shorter, spontaneous rides for the pure fun of it.</p></div>
    <div class="card"><h3>Special rides and events</h3><p>Rallies, runs and club days, like The Mielie 300 Run.</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>How a ride works</h2>
    <p data-hide>We usually ride on <strong data-c="rideDay"></strong>.</p>
    <p data-hide>We meet at <strong data-c="meeting"></strong>.</p>
    <p>We start with a quick rider briefing, ride together and regroup at stops. Message us to hear about the next ride.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>Ride etiquette</h2>
    <ul class="list"><li>Roadworthy bike, helmet and proper gear.</li><li>Stay in formation and ride to your ability.</li><li>Respect the road and other road users.</li><li>Look out for each other. Nobody gets left behind.</li></ul>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- GALLERY -->
<section class="pg" data-page="gallery" hidden>
  <h1>Gallery</h1>
  <p class="muted" style="margin-top:.5rem">Every ride has a story. Here's where we've been.</p>
  <div id="gal" class="gal"></div>
  <div id="galEmpty" class="empty"><h3>Photos coming soon</h3><p>We're putting our best ride photos here. Follow us to see them first.</p></div>
  <div class="btns" data-hide><a class="btn g" data-c="album">See the full photo album</a></div>
</section>

<!-- EVENTS -->
<section class="pg" data-page="events" hidden>
  <h1>Events</h1>
  <div class="sec"><div class="band">
    <h2>The Mielie 300 Run</h2>
    <p class="when">Saturday 7 November, starts 10:00, at Old Chaps Vryburg</p>
    <p>A 300km ride for the keen, and a day jol for everyone else. Every entry includes a cloth badge.</p>
    <ul class="tiers">
      <li><strong>300km ride: R300 per person</strong><span>Pre-entry only. Limited to 60 bikes.</span></li>
      <li><strong>Day jol: R100 per person</strong><span>All welcome.</span></li>
      <li><strong>Day jol, pay at the gates: R350 per person</strong><span>All welcome.</span></li>
    </ul>
    <p>Cash bar on site with refreshments all day. Please leave the cooler box at home.</p>
    <h3>Entries and queries</h3>
    <div class="btns">
      <a class="tile" href="tel:+27715262515">Dian, President<small>071 526 2515</small></a>
      <a class="tile" href="tel:+27832717313">Muller, Vice President<small>083 271 7313</small></a>
    </div>
    <img class="poster" alt="Poster for The Mielie 300 Run, 7 November at Old Chaps Vryburg" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
  </div></div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>Past events</h2><p>Look through the gallery for photos from our past rides and events.</p>
    <div class="btns"><a class="btn g" href="#gallery" data-go="gallery">Open the gallery</a></div></div>
</section>

<!-- JOIN -->
<section class="pg" data-page="join" hidden>
  <h1>Ready to ride with the crew?</h1>
  <p class="muted" style="margin-top:.5rem">Joining is simple and friendly.</p>
  <ol class="steps">
    <li><strong>Say hi</strong>Message us on WhatsApp or fill in the short form.</li>
    <li><strong>Come on a ride</strong>Meet the crew. No obligation.</li>
    <li><strong>See if we click</strong>Enjoy a few rides together.</li>
    <li><strong>Become one of us</strong>We'll chat about membership and club colours when you're ready.</li>
  </ol>
  <div class="btns"><a class="btn p" data-c="whatsapp">Message us on WhatsApp</a></div>
  <div class="btns" data-hide><a class="btn g" data-c="form">Fill in the join form</a></div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>Who can join</h2><p>Any rider with a valid licence and a roadworthy bike, from any experience level.</p></div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>Questions</h2>
    <details><summary>I'm a new rider. Is that okay?</summary><p>Absolutely. We ride at an easy pace and look out for each other.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Do I need a big bike?</summary><p>Bring what you ride. All bikes are welcome.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Do I have to come to every ride?</summary><p>No. Come when you can.</p></details>
    <details><summary>What does it cost?</summary><p>Come on a ride first, with no obligation. Message us and we'll explain membership when you're ready.</p></details>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CONTACT -->
<section class="pg" data-page="contact" hidden>
  <h1>Let's talk bikes</h1>
  <p class="muted" style="margin-top:.5rem">Questions, rides, or just saying hi. We'd love to hear from you.</p>
  <div class="grid c2">
    <a class="tile" data-c="whatsapp">WhatsApp us<small>The quickest way to reach us</small></a>
    <a class="tile" data-hide data-c="email">Email us<small data-c="email"></small></a>
    <a class="tile" data-hide data-c="facebook">Facebook<small>Follow our rides</small></a>
    <a class="tile" data-hide data-c="instagram">Instagram<small>See the latest photos</small></a>
  </div>
  <div class="sec"><h2>Find us</h2>
    <p>The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C., Vryburg, North West, South Africa.</p>
    <p data-hide>We meet at <strong data-c="meeting"></strong>.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>The Heath's Vryburg M.C.C. Vryburg, North West, South Africa. Ride safe, ride together.</footer>
</main>

<script>
/* ===== EDIT THESE ===== */
var C = {
  whatsapp: '27715262515', // club WhatsApp number, international format, no + or spaces
  email: '',               // e.g. club@example.com
  facebook: '',            // full link to your Facebook page
  instagram: '',           // full link to your Instagram page
  meeting: '',             // e.g. Old Chaps, Vryburg
  rideDay: '',             // e.g. the first Sunday of the month
  form: '',                // link to your join form (Google Form)
  album: ''                // link to a shared photo album
};
var GALLERY = [            // add photos like: ['https://...jpg', 'Caption']
];
/* ======================= */
document.querySelectorAll('[data-c]').forEach(function(el){
  var k=el.getAttribute('data-c'), v=C[k], box=el.closest('[data-hide]')||el;
  if(!v){box.hidden=true;return;}
  if(el.tagName==='A'){
    el.href = k==='whatsapp' ? 'https://wa.me/'+v : k==='email' ? 'mailto:'+v : v;
    if(k!=='email'){el.target='_blank';el.rel='noopener';}
  } else { el.textContent=v; }
});
var g=document.getElementById('gal');
GALLERY.forEach(function(p){
  var f=document.createElement('figure'),i=document.createElement('img');
  i.src=p[0];i.alt=p[1]||'Club ride photo';i.loading='lazy';f.appendChild(i);
  if(p[1]){var c=document.createElement('figcaption');c.textContent=p[1];f.appendChild(c);}
  g.appendChild(f);
});
document.getElementById('galEmpty').hidden = GALLERY.length>0;
var pages=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]')),
    links=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('nav a'));
function go(id){
  pages.forEach(function(p){p.hidden = p.getAttribute('data-page')!==id;});
  links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle('on', a.getAttribute('data-go')===id);});
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var a=e.target.closest('[data-go]'); if(!a)return;
  e.preventDefault(); go(a.getAttribute('data-go'));
});
go('home');
</script>
</body>
</html>
